# DELETE /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{index}/reactions

Remove a reaction from an issue

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** token · **ID:** `ep-305`

| Param | Location | Type | Required |

| owner | path | string | True |

| index | path | integer (int64) | True |

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Cannot add/remove reaction on locked issue without write permission (issue-level) | authorization | issue.IsLocked && !ctx.Repo.Permission.CanWriteIssuesOrPulls(issue.IsPull) |

### Error Paths

- **issue not found** → changeIssueReaction → 404
- **issue locked and no write permission** → changeIssueReaction → 403
